release.content: pubkit 0.42.0 was released on 2026-11-17 from commit d5f9af07353bbc26a11aaf4dd60e8b3b2532f7b8 with these changes.

rows: protect turns on a public repository's dependency graph and Dependabot alerts, which the review job's dependency review needs and GitHub leaves off on a new repository; protect --check reports them off

The pytest plugin is pubtest's: pubkit no longer carries pubkit.plugin or a pytest11 entry point, nor depends on pytest, and the managed tests/requirements-pubkit.txt pins pubtest 0.1.0, which gives every suite the same fixtures (ctx, binary, run), the same steps and the rest of GRAMMAR.md; a suite that imported pubkit.plugin imports pubtest.core

release.scope: the published release v0.42.0 of pubkit
